title: Should Google Go Nuclear? Clean, cheap, nuclear power...
summary: A 2006 Google Tech Talk by Robert Bussard on inertial electrostatic confinement (polywell) fusion as a cheap, clean alternative to conventional thermonuclear reactors. He argues it could be made viable with modest funding.
why: Cited as Bussard's last substantial public presentation on polywell fusion and the source of his claim that about $200M would be enough.

quote.text: it's an intense, fast-paced, insightful, and (likely) final public look into his mind, his work, and his character.
